objective: Deliver a working LLM-driven iterative artifact editor (React + HTMX) — create → display → edit again via natural language → re-display across turns → save to local library — driven by typed AG-UI-style streaming chunks and an editor state machine.
type: design-heavy feature build (not a bug patch)

branch_policy.notes: Per CLAUDE.md, build on the 1.9.x line; never use v2.

decisions.edit_transport: full-file rewrite per turn first; base-anchored diffs are a later optimization
decisions.edit_engine_and_loop: chat model via structured output/tool, renderer-orchestrated loop; typed AG-UI-style events modeled on top (NOT a dedicated agent-runtime session for v1)

open_questions_resolved.designer_surface: extend ArtifactPopup into a 3-pane designer (chat|code|preview) behind mode='designer'; no new window in v1
